QuestInfo.name: King of the Yetis
QuestInfo.0: Bitsie is injured after coming between the snow monster and the angry mob, and the snow monster flees.\r\nDid you make the right choice? Where did the snow child go? And what will Bitsie say when she finds out what happened?
